dimensions.name: Terminology
dimensions.definition: Errors arising when a term does not conform to normative subject field or organizational terminology standards or when a term in the target content is not the correct, normative equivalent of the corresponding term in the source content.

subtypes.name: Inconsistent with terminology resource
subtypes.definition: Use of a term that differs from term usage required by a specified termbase or other resource.

subtypes.name: inconsistent use of terminology
subtypes.definition: Use of multiple terms for the same concept in cases where consistency is desirable.

subtypes.name: wrong term
subtypes.definition: Use of term that it is not the term a domain expert would use or because it gives rise to a conceptual mismatch.

dimensions.name: Accuracy
dimensions.definition: Errors occurring when the target content does not accurately correspond to the propositional content of the source text because of distortion, omission, or addition to the message.

subtypes.name: Mistranslation
subtypes.definition: Error occuring when the target content that does not accurately represent the source content.

subtypes.name: Overtranslation
subtypes.definition: Error occuring in the target content that is inappropriately more specific than the source content.

subtypes.name: Undertranslation
subtypes.definition: Error occuring in the target content that is inappropriately less specific than the source content.

subtypes.name: Addition
subtypes.definition: Error occuring in the target content that includes content not present in the source.

subtypes.name: Omission
subtypes.definition: Error where content present in the source is missing in the target.

subtypes.name: Do not translate
subtypes.definition: Error occuring when a text segment marked "Do not transalate!" is translated in the target text.

subtypes.name: Untranslated
subtypes.definition: Error occuring when a text segment that was intended for translation is omitted in the target content.

dimensions.name: Linguistic conventions
dimensions.definition: Errors related to the linguistic well-formedness of the text, including problems with grammaticality, idiomaticity, and mechanical correctness.

subtypes.name: Grammar
subtypes.definition: Error that occurs when a text string (sentence, phrase, other) in the translation violates the grammatical rules of the target language.

subtypes.name: Punctuation
subtypes.definition: Punctuation incorrect according to target language conventions.

subtypes.name: Spelling
subtypes.definition: Error occurring when a word is misspelled.

subtypes.name: Unintelligible
subtypes.definition: Text garbled or incomprehensible.

subtypes.name: Character encoding
subtypes.definition: Error occuring when characters garbled due to incorrect application of an encoding.

subtypes.name: Textual conventions
subtypes.definition: Error that occurs when a text string (word, phrase, sentence, phrase, other) violates the text-building (discourse)norms of the target language.

dimensions.name: Style
dimensions.definition: Errors occurring in a text that are grammatically acceptable but are inappropriate because they deviate from organizational style guides or exhibit inappropriate language style.

subtypes.name: Organization style
subtypes.definition: Errors occuring where text violates third-party style guidelines.

subtypes.name: Third-party style
subtypes.definition: Errors occuring where text violates third-party style guidelines.

subtypes.name: Inconsistent with external reference
subtypes.definition: Errors occuring when text fails to conform wth a declared external style reference.

subtypes.name: Language register
subtypes.definition: Characteristic of text that uses a level of formality higher or lower than required by the specifications or general language conventions.

subtypes.name: Awkward style
subtypes.definition: Style involving excessive wordiness or overly embedded clauses, often due to inappropriate retention of source text style in the target text.

subtypes.name: Unidiomatic style
subtypes.definition: Style that is grammatical, but unnatural.

subtypes.name: Inconsistent style
subtypes.definition: Style that varies inconsistently throught the text.

dimensions.name: Locale conventions
dimensions.definition: Errors occurring when the translation product violates locale-specific content or formatting requirements for data elements.

subtypes.name: Number format
subtypes.definition: inappropriate number format for its locale.

subtypes.name: Currency format
subtypes.definition: Incorrect currency format for its locale.

subtypes.name: Measurement format
subtypes.definition: Inappropriate measurement format for its locale.

subtypes.name: Time format
subtypes.definition: Error involving incorrrect time format for its locale.

subtypes.name: Date format
subtypes.definition: Error involving inappropriate date format for its locale.

subtypes.name: Address format
subtypes.definition: Error involving inappropriate address format for locale.

subtypes.name: Telephone format
subtypes.definition: Error involving inappropriate telephone number form for locale.

subtypes.name: Shortcut key
subtypes.definition: Shortcuts in translated software product non-compliant with locale expectations or meaningless for locale.

dimensions.name: Audience appropriateness
dimensions.definition: Error where content Inappropriately uses a culture-specific reference that will not be understandable to the intended audience.

subtypes.name: Culture-specific reference
subtypes.definition: Error where content Inappropriately uses a culture-specific reference that will not be understandable to the intended audience.

subtypes.name: Offensive
subtypes.definition: Content that breaches commonly accepted standards of decent and proper speech, and is hence likely to offend the intended audience or other likely readers.

dimensions.name: Design and markup
dimensions.definition: Errors related to the physical design or presentation of a translation product, including character, paragraph, and UI element formatting and markup, integration of text with graphical elements, and overall page or window layout.

subtypes.name: Layout
subtypes.definition: Inappropriate presentation format of paragraphs, headings, graphical elements, and user interface elements and their arrangement on a form, page, website, or application screen.

subtypes.name: Markup tag
subtypes.definition: Incorrect markup tag or tag component.

subtypes.name: Truncation/text expansion
subtypes.definition: Target content that is longer or shorter than allowed or where there is a significant and inappropriate discrepancy between the source and the target content lengths.

subtypes.name: Missing text
subtypes.definition: Existing text missing in the final laid-out version

subtypes.name: Link/cross-reference
subtypes.definition: Incorrect or invalid (no longer active) link or URI.
